Life Cycle Management
Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) is an analytical 
methodology to analyse and quantify environ-
mental aspects and impacts of product systems 
(e.g. materials, products, processes, buildings) 
over their life cycle (figure 21). Application inclu-
des product development and product improve-
ment, amongst other uses. A substantial amount 
of product and process-specific data has alrea-
dy been compiled in a standardised way (e.g. in 
EPDs, LCA databases). The relevant informati-
on can be linked to the corresponding materials 
passports to avoid multiple data collection.
